entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I need to start a return for an order.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF886753.

Thank you, Sam. I see the order here for the Urban Commuter Helmet. It looks like it was delivered about two months ago. To start the process, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. Honestly, the color just wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. The box is still unopened, so the helmet is in perfect condition.
I understand completely. Getting the right color is important. Let me just pull up our current return policy for you. One moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've confirmed that your helmet is still well within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label.

That's great news, thank you. Now, since I'm going through the hassle of shipping it back and I'm planning to buy another one, is there any way you could provide a 10% discount code for my next purchase?

I'm glad I can get the full refund approved for you, Sam. However, I'm not authorized to issue discount codes for returns based on preference. The best I can do is ensure you receive your full refund as soon as we receive the item back at our warehouse.
I see. No partial credit or anything for the inconvenience? Just checking all my options.

I understand you're asking, but our policy is firm on this. We can only offer the full refund for the item itself. My main goal is to make sure you find the right gear, as your safety is our top priority, and we want you to be happy with your VeloFit products.
Alright, that's fair enough. The full refund is what I was hoping for anyway. Please send over that label.
Of course. The email with the shipping label is on its way to you now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off with the carrier. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
